verdicts.reason: A: the four benefit bullets are split into three places and in the wrong order (bubbles and honey on the left, blood orange in the middle, herbs on the far right). The logo is pushed into a tiny pill beside the CTA instead of leading. The teal circle has come apart from the shoe and is cropped at the right edge. The legal line is as large as the body copy and sits where the brand should be. B has the same scattered, out-of-order bullets, and it is worse: the logo pill collides with the 'Find Harbor' tagline, the legal text is lifted to the top right as if it were a heading, the shoe is crammed against the headline at the left, and the circle sits on its own, cropped at the far right. Neither is shippable; A is less broken because nothing overlaps.
